column1: # AO row list (docs/algorithm-optimization-prd.md section 4). Owner: Echo. One line per AO row ID, no wildcards.
# Columns, tab-separated: id, state before its slice, reason code of that state, slice from which the row is PASS, source.
# '-' in state and reason: the row is PASS from its slice, and its slice is S0. source: suite (acceptance/) or bench (the S0
# benchmark report, acceptance/ao-bench-schema.md). The check AO-0.row-list-matches compares a run with this file.
